description: This file defines the ManageReviewMenuConfigurator class which implements menu configuration logic for the performance review feature within the OrangeHRM system. It overrides the screen for the performance review search functionality.

classes.name: ManageReviewMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring menu behavior for the performance review section, particularly overriding the screen when the menu is accessed.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default screen for performance review searching within the menu configuration context.
